screens.penny: Hi, {name}! Let's pick something to save for.

screens.title: A saving goal

cards.caption: A goal is the thing you are saving for.
You add a little at a time until you have enough.

screens.penny: Picking a goal makes saving easier, {name}.

screens.rightMessage: Yes, {name}! A goal is the thing you are saving for.
screens.wrongMessage: Good try, {name}! A goal is the thing you want, like the teddy bear.

screens.story: Ana wants a kite. It costs 6 coins. She has 2 coins today.

options.label: Keep saving each week
options.outcome: Ana saves 2 more coins each week. Soon she has 6, and she buys the kite!

options.label: Give up on the kite
options.outcome: Ana stops saving. The kite stays in the shop. Her coins go on other things.

screens.rightMessage: Yes, {name}! A little at a time adds up to a goal.
screens.wrongMessage: Good try, {name}! Ana can still get there. She just needs a few more weeks of saving.

screens.prompt: The kite costs 6 coins. Put 6 coins in Ana's jar.
screens.rightMessage: That's 6, {name}! Ana can buy her kite.
screens.retryIntro: Let's count for the kite again, {name}.

screens.title: You did it, {name}!
screens.message: A goal gives your saving a job to do.
